cp13.name: cp(13) cluster profile
cp13.reference: Liu B. et al. (2014). iDNA-Prot|dis: identifying DNA-binding proteins by incorporating amino acid distance-pairs and reduced alphabet profile into the general pseudo amino acid composition. PLoS ONE, 9(9), e106691.
cp13.source_note: Eq. 10 of the paper (image pone.0106691.e027); transcribed 2026-10-12.

cp14.name: cp(14) cluster profile
cp14.reference: Liu B. et al. (2014). iDNA-Prot|dis: identifying DNA-binding proteins by incorporating amino acid distance-pairs and reduced alphabet profile into the general pseudo amino acid composition. PLoS ONE, 9(9), e106691.
cp14.source_note: Eq. 10 of the paper prints cp(14) = {EIMV; L; F; WY; G; P; C; A; S; T; N; HRKQ; E; D}, listing E twice. The paper fixes n(c)=14 (dimension 14+14x14x3=602), so the stray E in the first cluster is a typo: dropping it is the only reading with 14 clusters that partitions the 20 residues. Transcribed 2026-10-12.

ctd_ifeature_extra.name: Six additional CTD property partitions (iFeature 13-property CTD)
ctd_ifeature_extra.reference: iFeature: Chen Z. et al. (2018). iFeature: a Python package and web server for features extraction and selection from protein and peptide sequences. Bioinformatics, 34(14), 2499-2502. Following Dubchak I. et al. (1995). PNAS, 92(19), 8700-8704.
ctd_ifeature_extra.source_note: Three-group partitions for the six AAindex hydrophobicity properties used by iFeature's 13-property CTD (Table/Supplementary of iFeature, cross-checked against the iFeature reference implementation; data only, no code copied). Transcribed 2026-10-12.
